comments.note: tests/helpers/fixtures.ts uses import type for all three imported types — no runtime imports, ESM-correct .js extension. makePipeline uses new Date().toISOString() for started_at, giving non-deterministic timestamps. Tests that need exact started_at comparisons must override this field. For most test uses (behavioral assertions, not structural equality) this is fine. Non-blocking.

tests/integration/full-workflow.test.ts line 769 seeds revision:1 to test COMPLETE->IN_PROGRESS increment yields revision:2. This is a correct and deliberate exception to the bulk revision:0 rule. However, there is no inline comment explaining the intent — a future bulk-replace automation could silently break this test. Recommend adding a comment: '// Deliberate: seeds revision:1 to verify COMPLETE->IN_PROGRESS increment yields revision:2'.

QA identified an additional pre-existing regex gap: src/tools/observations.ts AddObservationSchema (line 21) still uses /^WP-\d{3}$/. Combined with CompletePipelineSchema (pipeline.ts line 234), there are now two known schemas that will reject 4+ digit WP IDs. Both are pre-existing, out of scope for this phase, and tracked. The follow-up micro-WP noted in project comments should fix both.
